subject.title: feat(plugins): upgrade llm_input/llm_output hooks from fire-and-forget to modifying

question: Should OpenClaw preserve `llm_input` and `llm_output` as observer-only hooks and add a distinct versioned modifier API, or intentionally make the existing public hook names synchronous control points across every runner?
rationale: This choice changes the established plugin contract, agent latency model, and the security semantics of installed plugins; source review cannot select the permanent public API on maintainers’ behalf.

options.title: Add a distinct modifier API
options.body: Preserve the existing observer hooks and introduce explicitly named modifier hooks with documented runner coverage and capability boundaries.

options.title: Adopt the in-place contract change
options.body: Accept that existing hook names become awaited control points, document the upgrade behavior, and require all supported runners to consume results consistently.

options.title: Pause the feature
options.body: Keep the current observer-only contract until there is a maintainer-sponsored plugin interception design.

recommendation.title: Add a distinct modifier API
recommendation.body: Preserve the existing observer hooks and introduce explicitly named modifier hooks with documented runner coverage and capability boundaries.

likelyOwner.reason: The timeline routes this API-direction discussion to steipete, while the decision spans core plugin and runner behavior.
